reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount used by preview, posting, action sync, forecast and the UI, reuses getApproxNumberThreshold, and replaces the schedule-template midpoint copy with a call to it.

duplication.why: The worst-case rule is written once; the last inline midpoint copy (schedule-template) is removed.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, but expectedAmount is attached in the api.ts handler by spreading over scheduleModel.toExternal instead of inside the api-models mapper that owns the external shape.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and API field; passing the op to display call sites changes UI amounts too, consistent with the rule but beyond what the API step asked, and a Balance comment is left stating the step-1 wording.

maintainability.why: One tested helper with a clear worst-case branch; inserting amountOp before inverse reorders a positional parameter, which is easy to misuse.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all callers go through getScheduledAmount (the API handler adds expectedAmount outside scheduleModel but via the same helper)

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts gains an amountOp parameter (inserted before inverse) for the approximate case; no special-case branches, and every amount call site, including schedule-template and the API handler, uses it
